title: Quick Flaky Turkish Meat Manti
description: A simplified and rich version of traditional Turkish manti, made with ground meat, flaky dough, and a tangy yogurt sauce. Perfect for a cozy sick day meal.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: use a low-protein flour for easier dough

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, salt, and black pepper.
Gradually add the softened butter and mix until the dough comes together in a ball.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, prepare the filling by mixing the ground lamb, yogurt, garlic, and onion in a separate bowl.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each one into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the filling in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling, forming a triangle, and press the edges to seal.
Place the manti in a 12-cup mason jar, leaving some space between each one.
Brush the tops of the manti with a little bit of butter and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the manti from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
